intent: Build Aharon Zev localhost pilot: five chunks plus weekly test, strict 54/60 gate, saved attempts, parent grading, sample tickets and idempotent prize checkout, three playable game prototypes and separate design lab. Live AI, voice and production accounts remain explicitly disconnected.

requirements.requirement: Five daily chunks and weekly test
Server hides answer keys before submission
Open responses pending parent review when AI disconnected
Saved attempts and one-time chunk awards
Checkout deduction once and unchanged lifetime earnings
Three playable game prototypes and separate design exploration

requirements_completeness.basis: Current source contains each first-pilot capability; this is not production deployment approval.

testing_gaps: Add an on-disk close/reopen test for attempts, finalized scores, wallet balance, and purchase deduplication.
Add parent-route integration coverage for rejected unauthenticated grading, session-cookie issuance, and authenticated grading.
Test successful and duplicate game-run saves, including unchanged wallet and lifetime tickets.

resolved_findings.title: Persist incomplete drafts and cleared answers
resolved_findings.evidence: Resolved in current source: for a partial matching answer or cleared written answer followed by navigation, src/components/learning-app.tsx:138-164 and :226-260 save changed drafts without completeness guards, src/lib/rules.ts:69-87 accepts partial mappings and empty strings, and src/lib/store.ts:224-226 persists them while :234-235 retains strict submission validation; this directly refutes the alleged draft loss and stale cleared-answer submission.

resolved_findings.title: Preserve unsaved rubric selections on other responses
resolved_findings.evidence: Resolved in current source: when two pending responses have selected criteria and the first is graded, src/components/parent-review.tsx:31-40 functionally retains every selection whose response remains pending, src/app/api/parent/route.ts:36-37 returns the updated review list, and src/lib/store.ts:353-365 includes the other ungraded response, refuting the alleged blanket clearing and consequent zero score.

resolved_findings.title: Retain failed game saves for an idempotent retry
resolved_findings.evidence: Resolved in current source: after a failed or lost game-save response, src/components/games.tsx:29-48 retains a stable run ID and marks success only after awaiting confirmation, :85-97 displays failure with an explicit retry and permits replay only after success, src/components/learning-app.tsx:816-822 returns the actual save outcome using that same ID, and src/lib/store.ts:304 deduplicates retries, refuting the alleged unrecoverable failure and false saved message.

resolved_findings.title: Editing during Save & continue loses the newer response
resolved_findings.evidence: Resolved in current source: the alleged ordering requires an input edit while Save & continue awaits its response, but src/components/learning-app.tsx:209-224 holds committing true throughout save and navigation, :744-748 passes it to QuestionInput, :1205-1210, :1224-1232 and :1248-1253 disable all three input kinds, and :243-261 blocks competing navigation, eliminating the newer editable draft in the reported sequence.
